messages:
Maya (Marketing): quick idea — let’s run a 30m webinar that is half demo, half live troubleshooting. target: engineers evaluating inference economics. looking for 1-2 speakers + a short customer vignette. available dates: Thu 4/14 or Tue 4/19. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Josh (Growth): love that. framing suggestion: "Practical tradeoffs — cost, latency, and reliability in production". 20m demo + 10m Q&A. i can present the customer flow and CTA. :+1:
Andrea (Product): agree on framing. i can draft a 2-sentence abstract now: "We’ll walk through real-world cost/latency decisions and demo how to tune batching, quantization, and routing policies for production workloads." happy to sync on slides.
Diego (Eng): for the demo: recommend pre-recording the heavy model swap part and doing a live short troubleshooting session against Dedicated. less risk. fallback plan: if live inference degrades, swap to recorded clip and continue with Q&A.
Maya (Marketing): good call, diego. can you paste the fallback snippet we can keep in the run-of-show?
Diego (Eng): sure — short CLI to replay a recorded session or toggle fallback model:
```
# replay recording
redwood demo replay --file demos/latency-fallback.mp4
# switch to lightweight model
redwood api set-model --deployment web-demo --model small-v1
```
Josh (Growth): routing + lead capture: we should gate the recording behind a short form that tags traffic by customer-size. prefer HubSpot form + utm. sam, any constraints on recording landing?
Sam Deploy Bot: calendar event created: "Webinar rehearsal — Practical inference pilot" Thu 4/7 10:00-11:00 (organizer: Maya).
Andrea (Product): abstract draft for sign-up copy: "Join our engineers for a hands-on session exploring how teams cut inference costs without sacrificing latency. Live demo + troubleshooting, examples from production." feedback?
Maya (Marketing): copy looks good. add a line: "Ideal for infra/platform/ML engineers building inference features."
Josh (Growth): run-of-show (tight):
- 0:00–2:00: host intro + agenda
- 2:00–8:00: customer vignette (pre-recorded)
- 8:00–26:00: live demo + guided troubleshooting (diego + josh)
- 26:00–30:00: rapid Q&A + CTA to demo signup
Diego (Eng): rehearsal asks: 1) show start-to-finish demo with pre-recorded swap 2) verify streaming works for low-latency snippets 3) test fallback commands (i'll script them).
Maya (Marketing): assign: diego — demo script + fallback record by Mon 4/4; andrea — final abstract + slides by Wed 4/6; josh — landing page & form by Wed 4/6. i'll book two 30m rehearsals (tech dry-run + full run).
Josh (Growth): noted. i'll also wire up utm params and a hidden field for "company_size" for lead routing.
Andrea (Product): can someone add a 1-slide customer data point (latency/cost delta)? i have numbers but need a visual.
Diego (Eng): i'll make a quick chart from the benchmark data and drop it in slides.
Maya (Marketing): perfect. one more thing — social snippets after event: 2 short posts (launch + on-demand), and a 1-paragraph benchmark highlights email. i'll draft and share tomorrow. :rocket:
Josh (Growth): :thumbsup: thanks all — see you at the rehearsal.
Maya (Marketing): thanks — closing thread. any last-minute blockers pls ping me directly.
